text: Ko onon yo ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah, ɓe jokki sari'a Makko on, ne'anee Nulaaɗo Makko on, hara on townaali sowtooji mon ɗin e hoore sowto Annabaajo on (yo o his) tuma yewtoton mo, wata on ewnor kadi innde makko nden, wano yoga mon ewnorta yoga; noddiree mo newaare wiide Annabiijo e Nulaaɗo; fii wata golle mon ɗen bonir sabu ɗum, hara on so'aa-anndude ɗum.
